source_document: CEDEX for MITECO, Trasvases en España, apartado 2.11 Mancomunidad de Aguas del Río Algodor (pp. 144-147)
notes: Since 2005 the Mancomunidad takes Tajo water at the Almoguera reservoir and treats it at the Algodor plant in Noblejas; its original intake, the Finisterre reservoir on the Algodor, 'ha ido quedando en desuso' (CEDEX), so it is left out: its 133 hm3 would outweigh the source actually used.
